DESIGN §5.5 F16: BUY water_1@C1, MOVE the existing Hi off C2 to vacate it, MOVE the new Sjor C1->C2, ATTACK the enemy on C3 — the purchase fills the last spawn square (C1) immediately after the BUY, but C1 is legal again by the end of the turn, so a generator that rejects on the immediate post-BUY spawn count would wrongly discard the only punishing line.
